tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Gall (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

Yesterday, my sister came over after running a few errands for me. She and I had dinner together that I had made for her. It was chili and cornbread. She quite enjoyed it and we enjoyed eating some Stroopwafels after that, that she had picked up at the store yesterday for me.
